treatment_summary: The patient is a 92‑year‑old man with presumed HFrEF, severe CKD (eGFR ≈ 7), and multiple comorbidities. Guideline‑directed therapy includes continuation of the beta‑blocker metoprolol and the ARB irbesartan (already prescribed). A low‑dose loop diuretic (furosemide 20 mg daily) is added to treat congestion. ACE‑I, MRA, and SGLT2‑i are contraindicated or unsafe given the very low eGFR and unknown potassium, so they are not started. All existing cardiovascular and transplant medications are continued with monitoring for hypotension, renal function, and electrolyte disturbances. Key monitoring includes serum creatinine, potassium, blood pressure, heart rate, and daily weight. Non‑pharmacological measures (fluid and sodium restriction, weight monitoring, smoking cessation, vaccinations, cardiac rehabilitation) are recommended. Specialist review by heart‑failure and renal teams is advised within two weeks.
